findings.quote: Consultation with TTC The TTC has expressed interest in consolidating other nearby midblock stops on Clonmore Drive into stops at the subject intersection, should the requested traffic control signal be approved.
findings.rule: consolidating other nearby midblock stops on Clonmore Drive into stops

findings.quote: At least one sidewalk will remain open at all times, with signed detours and controlled crossings at Gerrard Street East and the PXO at Langley Avenue.
The northbound far side transit stop on Carlaw Avenue at Gerrard Street will be temporarily located to the south side of the intersection in front of 375 Carlaw Avenue.
Temporary relocation of transit stops will be required at some locations to avoid conflicts with active work zones.

Temporary road and sidewalk closures for these activities will be coordinated with the Gerrard Portal traffic management plan to maintain safe and continuous access for local residents, emergency services, and construction vehicles.

As Gerrard Portal construction progresses (Stages 1A to 1C), temporary sidewalk closures will occur along Carlaw Avenue, between Gerrard Avenue and Langley Avenue for driveway modifications and temporary traffic signal installation.
